card.name: Linking words before co-medication or condition terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word starts (of, for, taking, using, other, De- in decongestant) in drug-interaction and precaution passages, right before a named drug class or condition.

modes.label: Verbs of taking a drug
modes.description: Words like taking, using, take after 'patients' or 'women who', leading into a list of other medications.
modes.example: patients<< taking>> medications sensitive to serum potassium concentrations

modes.label: Linking words before a condition or product
modes.description: Of, for, other that introduce the next drug, product or disease in warnings and interaction tables.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of<< other>> potentially irritating topical products

modes.label: Start of decongestant
modes.description: The 'De' that begins the word decongestant after nasal.
modes.example: Nasal Corticosteroid or Nasal<< De>>congestant Patients who require a nasal
